checkpoints.description: Task 'dustline-survivors-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Deepen the survivor loop: swept bullet collisions, a dashing escape move with i-frames, a fifth-wave Warlord boss with health bar and guaranteed loot, focus-loss auto-pause, and coverage for each

impact_assessment.why: Playtesting the v0.3.0 rewrite exposed bullets tunneling through thin runners, no answer to being surrounded, no wave climax, and death while the window was backgrounded
impact_assessment.benefits: Hit detection is continuous, players get a skill-based escape tool, every fifth wave has a goal and reward, and alt-tabbing no longer kills a run
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot gains dash/boss fields and three test seams; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: none persisted beyond existing keys
impact_assessment.mitigation: Deterministic VM tests for dash distance/cooldown, boss spawn/death loot and blur pause; all four project gates re-run

[1/1] Ship the survivor feature set: weapon/map/time-limit setup, versioned progress saving, armory meta upgrades, stats screen, 15 skills with 6 combos, bullet speed/lifesteal/dash damage, 4 maps with buildings/rocks/trees and map viewer, 7 mobs, 3 attacking bosses, red enemy bullets, manual cluster bomb, medkit magnetism, evolved character art, reworked HUD and layered audio

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for a much deeper survivor game: build variety, meta progression, more maps/mobs/bosses, clearer enemy fire and a readable HUD
impact_assessment.benefits: Meaningful pre-run choices, persistent goals, six combo payoffs, tactical cover, varied boss fights and clearer combat feedback
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save schema v2, snapshot fields, test seams, HUD layout, controls (E/M); dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: localStorage dustline.save and new snapshot/save contracts
impact_assessment.mitigation: 31 deterministic node:test cases covering every system, seeded autoplay to wave 10, ADR-001..005, 5/5 AIKit gates

[1/1] Port CyberPulse's behavioral design review into Dustline: variable-ratio kill rewards with jackpots and hardware chips, near-miss crit surge, extraction beacons with death loss, combo multiplier stake, Overdrive risk mode, sector alert with NetWatch hunters, seeded ambient events and news, run contracts, drifting market, plus Warden/Weaver/Splitter/Leech mobs and Colossus/Leviathan mega bosses after every three bosses

impact_assessment.why: The user asked to integrate CyberPulse's literature review (Self-Determination Theory, variable-ratio reinforcement, near-miss activation, loss aversion/prospect theory, flow channel) and to add more mechanics, enemies and big bosses
impact_assessment.benefits: Opt-in risk and reward, a reactive world, more enemy variety, a climax after the regular boss cycle, and persistent lifetime behavioural stats
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save schema gains counters and lastSeed, snapshot fields and test seams expand; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: localStorage dustline.save and the seeded LCG draw
impact_assessment.mitigation: 44 deterministic node:test cases, seeded autoplay through the wave-20 mega boss, Chromium smoke run with zero console errors, ADR-006

checkpoints.description: 44/44 node:test cases pass, 5/5 Phase 4 gates pass; probes confirmed jackpot/chips, near-miss surge, warden plating, splitter swarms, beacon banking and 50% death loss, wave-20 Colossus and wave-40 Leviathan phases, hunter deployment, supply/sandstorm/bounty events, overdrive multipliers, contracts, chip buffs and victory bonus; save counters persist across sessions; Chromium smoke run had zero console errors; checklists: passed; open: commit + push pending authorization

[1/1] Verification and hardening pass over the uncommitted v0.5/v0.6 work: fix the statistics grid overflow, HUD panel/boss-bar overlap, wasted extraction beacon, buffered dash/bomb/overdrive keys on level-up, abandoned-run banking and seed persistence, mid-death enemy updates, and the high-entropy secret-scan false positive

impact_assessment.why: The user asked to verify and analyze the changes, fix bugs and gaps, then push
impact_assessment.benefits: Correct statistics and HUD layout, no lost banking on quit/restart, no buffered actions after level-up, deterministic per-run seeds, and a clean full-history secret scan
impact_assessment.risks: contract: abandon now records a loss and burns unbanked shards; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: save.lastSeed is written at run start
impact_assessment.mitigation: 47 deterministic tests, two new regressions, Chromium smoke across stats/armory/weather/mega, full-repo secret scan, 5/5 gates

[1/1] Add build depth and replayability: weapon evolutions (Ripper/Storm/Breaker/Reaper), champion mobs with Volatile/Shielded/Swift affixes, supply caches with a fair free-upgrade cap, three difficulty tiers with matching loot, level-up rerolls and banishes, and Shielder/Tunneler/Screamer/Phantom wired into the real spawn table

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for continued improvements to mechanics, balance and mobs; v0.6 builds peaked early, difficulty was fixed, and four designed mobs only existed behind test seams
impact_assessment.benefits: Visible late-game build payoffs, scarce and valuable elites, player-chosen challenge with matching reward, mid-run build agency, and full use of the mob roster
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save gains champion/cache counters, snapshot/seams expand, level curve and XP pace change; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: setup gains difficulty and existing saves default it to normal
impact_assessment.mitigation: 56 deterministic tests including evolution, champions/caches, difficulty, rerolls, new-mob states and persistence; seeded 4-minute balance runs; Chromium smoke with zero console errors; ADR-007

checkpoints.description: 56/56 node:test cases (9 new) and 5/5 Phase 4 gates pass; full-repo secret scan clean; Chromium smoke verified difficulty cards, evolution, champions, caches, codex and statistics with zero console errors; seeded 4-minute autoplays on Normal and Nightmare reached all 15 regular mob types, 2-4 evolutions, champion affixes and screamer rage, at ~1.6ms simulated frame time; balance re-tuned after finding 12% champions + 2-upgrade caches maxed every skill in 4 minutes (now 3% champions, 1 upgrade, 10-cache cap, steeper 6+6 XP curve); checklists: passed
